action.description: plan: write the whole plan, replacing any previous one. add: append steps found mid-work. start: mark one in progress. done / drop: close one. note: record what a step turned up. list: read the whole list. clear: throw it away.

steps.description: The steps, one short imperative line each, in the order you intend to do them (plan, add)

note.description: What this step found, or why it was dropped -- one line, kept on the item so the list still means something later
